hookSites.displacedInstructions: Hooking with a jump at 0x001F36F0 displaces the jal (0x0C01C4B1) and its delay slot (0x8C84E8BC = lw $a0,-0x1744($a0)). Note the surrounding context: 0x001F36EC lui $a0,0x801D loads the high half BEFORE the hook; 0x001F36F8 lui $at,0x801D / 0x001F36FC sw $zero,-0x1744($at) clears the owner global immediately AFTER the call.
hookSites.likelyResumeZ64: 0x001F36F8 (the owner-global clear) for the vanilla path; the streamsplit guard re-implements/branches around the resource_free.
hookSites.likelyResumeRam: overlay-relocated; resolve via overlay map, not linear back-map.
hazards: DELAY-SLOT: $a0 is loaded from [0x801CE8BC] in the jal's delay slot (0x001F36F4) — a0 is NOT set before the jal; any hook MUST preserve/replicate that load.
REGISTER: $at is used at 0x001F36F8/0x001F36FC to clear the owner global right after the call; do not clobber $at across the hook.
PROLOGUE/EPILOGUE: the hook is mid-function (func_001F3540), well after its prologue and 5 preceding sub-cleanup jals; epilogue/return is at 0x001F3700..0x001F3710.
OVERLAY/RAM: this code is overlay-relocated; the parent RAM 0x801B0260 and the owner global 0x801CE8BC are RAM/overlay leads, not z64 back-maps.
